scalarCache.shownWindow: The original post-show short-circuit property reads are cached as two BOOLs; _content.window is still read only when shown is true. There is no extra property read, object retention or replacement action.
scalarCache.coordinates: The original single synchronizeContentCoordinates result is cached as BOOL; only the same true branch unhides content.

nativeObservation.storage: one last-branch slot and one last-show slot per existing component; no history array, timer, new event observer or input action
nativeObservation.current: read-only fields from the exact component on the main thread; missing owner/content observations remain null where appropriate
nativeObservation.markScope: synchronizePresentation entry; existing schedule generation plus private nonwrapping sequence and recycle lifetime
nativeObservation.updateOwnership: show-result updates require the exact captured invocation sequence, so a nested/newer show cannot receive an older call's result
nativeObservation.objectOwnership: weak owner/content/popover references; no new strong native visual ownership
nativeObservation.privateTokenStorage: existing immutable token objects are retained only internally for equality; their values are never returned
nativeObservation.historicalValidity: same recycle lifetime and exact weak owner/content/popover plus expected-command-owner binding
nativeObservation.historyQualifiers: scope-token, presentation-token, input-parameter and schedule-generation equality are separate booleans; false equality preserves valid historical results and never labels them current
nativeObservation.staleBoundary: actual owner/object/lifetime mismatch, missing capture or diagnostic overflow masks branch/show/geometry values to unknown
nativeObservation.recycle: diagnostic identities invalidate before the original recycle cleanup; original cleanup remains unchanged
nativeObservation.nativeExceptions: new Objective-C observation/copy/dictionary operations are caught using named NSException variables; failed diagnostic reads leave the existing native response usable
nativeObservation.geometry: finite components and finite right/bottom extents only; actual show anchor uses positioning-view coordinates, while current anchor and actual frame/region use owner-content top-left coordinates
nativeObservation.privacy: no raw tokens, memory addresses, arbitrary text, error strings, usernames, source paths or unbounded arrays are emitted

focusedChecks.reproductionAccounting: A reviewer rerun repeats these same eight designs; it does not add eight new designs or native runtime evidence.

sourceLimitations: The JavaScript harness executes extracted production selector/poll/recorder functions under V8 with mock IO/time/native responses; it does not execute Node filesystem APIs or AppKit.
The four short-circuit comparisons are a JavaScript model plus exact native source-form inspection, not an Objective-C execution result.
Exact forward/inverse transforms verify the complete source bytes; they do not replace the required actual native compile and acceptance run.
Historical branch/containment observations must be interpreted with their object/lifetime binding and equality flags; they do not by themselves establish the cause of a current failure.
No new native result, host configuration change, permission change, retry, public JavaScript API, source ref or published PR is claimed.
